meta.storyTitle: Make the scratchpad document view editable in-plugin (ISSUE-01ac1e4b6a6c9c2f)

override.reason: Daemon design review unavailable (ISSUE-738d62b8: reviewId review-lld-01ac1e4b6a6c9c2f-s1-r5 exhausted native retries with invalid_output, zero findings). Controller self-review recorded at docs/standalone/scratchpad-document-view-read-only-cannot-E2026111401ac1e4b/S001/LLD-SELF-REVIEW.md — 6 findings, all fixed. Content change since revision 1 (escaping raw <pre>/<textarea> tags in the source JSON body so the rendered markdown no longer swallows the document in the review pane) was reconciled as revision 2 with a matching update log entry; the user approved this LLD in chat after insrc_present returned both names presented.

alternativesConsidered.name: Editable textarea in the existing scratchpad webview + no-clobber updateScratch
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Make the existing 'insrc.scratchpad' document view's <pre> an editable <textarea>, add document-channel scratch-save/scratch-saved messages and ScratchStore.updateScratch with exclusive temp-write + unlink/link no-clobber publish.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Keep the existing singleton 'insrc.scratchpad' document webview; in documentBodyHtml replace the <pre id="insrc-scratchdoc"> with a <textarea id="insrc-scratchdoc"> (same id, CSP-safe: value set via .value, never innerHTML). Content push 'scratch-content' sets textarea.value. Bootstrap (now parameterised by gen AND id) adds: input listener marking dirty + showing a save button (and panel title suffix), Ctrl/Cmd+S and the save button posting new document-channel 'scratch-save' {id, gen: docGeneration, text: textarea.value}; the document panel's onMessage forwards 'scratch-save' to the host through a NEW ScratchPanelsDeps.onScratchSave seam (wired in extension.ts to the scratch-host route, exactly like the existing onSendToChat forward — the chat-channel SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES interception in extension.ts cannot see document-panel messages); the route replies host->webview 'scratch-saved' {id, gen, ok, error?} (routed via a new panels.replySaved) which clears dirty on ok / surfaces error. Both messages live in a NEW document-channel contract (ScratchDocWebviewToHost / ScratchDocHostToWebview unions + const arrays in scratch-panels.ts) — the chat-channel protocol.ts unions stay untouched, because scratch-content/scratch-ready already travel on the document panel's raw {v:1,payload} channel outside those unions. The host route calls new store.updateScratch(id, text) which validates id (inside root, regular file, no symlink), writes the temp file with exclusive no-follow creation (O_EXCL|O_CREAT|O_NOFOLLOW), publishes with the store's no-clobber unlink+link discipline over the destination. Selection-based send-to-chat is preserved by reading the textarea's own selection (selectionStart/selectionEnd over doc.value), not window.getSelection(). Minimal new surface: 2 document-channel message types, 1 store op, 2 panels ops (replySaved + onScratchSave seam), dirty flag in the controller.
pros: Smallest change that fully meets the ISSUE fix intent; keeps the singleton panel, generation/epoch guards, ready-replay handshake and wrap() delivery logging untouched
Reuses the existing CSP shell, nonce, bootstrap pattern and send-to-chat selection path (re-pointed from window.getSelection() to the textarea's selectionStart/selectionEnd)
updateScratch mirrors createScratch's existing security shape (id validation, temp file, publish), so invariants are preserved by construction
Dirty state + save affordance are webview-local; the host only gains one intent route
cons: A textarea is plain-text editing, not markdown preview — but the current view is already plain text, so no regression
no-clobber link publication must handle the destination being recreated concurrently (EEXIST retry, covered in error paths)

alternativesConsidered.name: contentEditable div in the document view
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Same save round-trip as a1 but the editable element is a contentEditable div fed via textContent/innerText.
alternativesConsidered.approach: contentEditable div instead of textarea: documentBodyHtml emits <div id="insrc-scratchdoc" contenteditable="true">; 'scratch-content' sets textContent as today; save posts 'scratch-save' {id, text: div.innerText}; same protocol additions and store op as a1.
pros: Keeps the textContent assignment path from the current bootstrap nearly unchanged
cons: contentEditable brings rich-text paste and DOM-mutation edge cases into a CSP-strict webview; innerText round-trips are less predictable than textarea.value
No advantage over textarea for a plain-markdown scratchpad
Harder to pin in source-scan tests (contenteditable attribute vs textarea value semantics)
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: contentEditable + innerText round-trips add rich-text paste and DOM-mutation edge cases into a CSP-strict webview; weaker testability in source-scan tests; same store-write need as a1 without its clean .value contract.

alternativesConsidered.name: Open the .md file in a native VS Code editor instead of the webview
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Replace the custom document webview with VS Code's native text editor on the scratchpad file.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Do not edit in the webview at all: 'scratch-open' opens the underlying ~/.insrc/scratches/<id>.md file in a real VS Code text editor (workspace.openTextDocument + showTextDocument) instead of the custom webview; editing/saving is native. The webview document view is kept only for send-to-chat, or dropped.
pros: Native editing, syntax highlighting, native save — zero custom editing code
The external file is the source of truth anyway
cons: Changes the UX fundamentally — the ISSUE asks for the scratchpad (the popup's opened view) to be editable; opening an external file editor changes the panel contract, tab identity, and the create-or-reveal singleton + generation/epoch machinery becomes dead code
Loses the floating send-to-chat button and the ISSUE-3183af2a popup behavior tied to the webview
Bigger blast radius: extension.ts wiring, viewType registration, tests all change; the plugin can no longer guarantee content flows through the store
Conflicts with the approved fix intent (editable surface + save through the store)
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Throws away the singleton panel machinery the earlier stories built and ISSUE-3183af2a hardened; cost M; changes UX away from the scratchpad view the ISSUE reports as read-only; contradicts the approved fix intent (editable surface + save through the store).

alternativesConsidered.name: Read-only webview + 'Edit' button opening the native editor
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Keep the webview as-is; add an 'Edit' icon button that opens the native editor on the file.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Keep the webview as-is; add an edit affordance that hands off to a native text editor on the .md file; the webview watches/re-reads on reveal. Save happens natively; browse refreshes on panel reveal.
pros: Native editing without replacing the webview
Small webview change (one button + one intent)
cons: The scratchpad view itself remains read-only — does not satisfy 'the scratchpad is not editable' as reported
Stale-content sync issue between webview and file
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Fails the ISSUE-01ac1e4b6a6c9c2f fix intent — the scratchpad view itself remains read-only, which is exactly the reported complaint; this is the status quo ac5 already scoped out.

api.signature: case 'scratch-save' in createScratchHost.onMessage  // vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-host.ts — NEW route, entered via the document-panel onScratchSave seam (NOT via the chat-channel SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES interception)

dataModelChanges.details: A NEW document-channel contract lives in vscode-plugin/src/panels/scratch-panels.ts (alongside the existing raw {v:1,payload} document messages scratch-content/scratch-ready, which are NOT in protocol.ts): ScratchDocWebviewToHost gains { type: 'scratch-save'; id: string; gen: number; text: string } and ScratchDocHostToWebview gains { type: 'scratch-saved'; id: string; gen: number; ok: boolean; error?: string }, each with its own const array (SCRATCH_DOC_WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES / SCRATCH_DOC_HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES) plus direction-isolation assertions in the panel test. The chat-channel protocol.ts unions and arrays stay UNTOUCHED (adding document messages there would break the compile-time union/array equality assertion, since those unions describe only the chat panel's channel). gen is carried on BOTH messages so the reply is generation-guarded end to end (the webview only honors scratch-saved whose gen equals its live docGeneration). Payload field names are part of the contract; ids/texts must be strings and gen a number at runtime.

ScratchStore gains updateScratch(id, text): the temp file (pid+random suffix, never *.md) is created EXCLUSIVELY and no-follow — open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW so a pre-existing temp-path symlink/regular file fails with EEXIST/ELOOP instead of being followed — then published over the destination with the store's existing no-clobber discipline: unlink(destination) + link(temp, destination) + unlink(temp), re-validating id (resolve strictly inside root, lstat regular file, symlink refused — O_NOFOLLOW discipline, and re-open the destination O_NOFOLLOW|fstat to confirm the same inode before unlinking so a symlink swapped in after lstat is never removed) after the destination is confirmed present; link() EEXIST on the destination (recreated concurrently) is handled by re-validating and retrying the unlink+link pair a bounded number of times, then ScratchStoreError. NEVER rename (rename would clobber a destination created after the existence probe). The ScratchFs adapter gains writeFileExclusive(path, data) (node: fs.open 'wx' + O_NOFOLLOW semantics; the test fake models EEXIST/ELOOP so symlink-occupied temp names are covered) plus the existing link/unlink/open ops. ScratchEntry shape unchanged.

Document view DOM: <pre class="scratch-doc"> becomes <textarea id="insrc-scratchdoc" class="scratch-doc">; content push sets .value; adds hidden save button, dirty tracking, Ctrl/Cmd+S, title suffix, 'scratch-saved' handling with gen guard (reply honored only when msg.gen === live docGeneration). documentBootstrap gains an id parameter (documentBootstrap(gen, id)) so the webview knows which scratchpad it shows and can post it in 'scratch-save'. Send-to-chat selection is re-pointed from window.getSelection() to the textarea's selectionStart/selectionEnd over doc.value (select/keyup/mouseup listeners) because textarea selections are not DOM Range selections. The document panel's onMessage now also forwards 'scratch-save' to the host via a NEW ScratchPanelsDeps.onScratchSave seam (checked against showingId + live docGeneration), because the chat-channel SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES interception in extension.ts only sees the chat panel's channel. Generation/epoch/ready-replay machinery and wrap() delivery logging unchanged. ScratchPanels gains replySaved(gen, msg) so the host can target the live document generation with the scratch-saved reply.

edgeCases.expected: Stale-generation 'scratch-saved' replies are ignored by the webview handler (same rule as scratch-ready)
edgeCases.input: 'scratch-saved' arriving with a gen older than the live docGeneration

edgeCases.expected: Dirty remains, error shown inline, log.warn recorded, browse/list still refresh

edgeCases.expected: Logged via the existing wrap() drop logging (ISSUE-3183af2a); dirty remains until a reply arrives
edgeCases.input: postMessage delivery fails or the wrapped handle rejects the 'scratch-saved' reply

errorCases.detection: At save time the id fails validation: not a *.md basename resolving strictly inside the store root, lstat shows not-a-regular-file, or the path is a symlink (O_NOFOLLOW discipline)
errorCases.response: Reject with ScratchRefused → host replies 'scratch-saved' {ok:false, error} + log.warn
errorCases.scenario: scratch-save arrives with a tampered/outside-root/symlink id
errorCases.userImpact: The save is refused and the dirty state stays; nothing is written outside the store root

errorCases.detection: ENOENT when the destination is re-validated at save time (deleted between open and save)
errorCases.scenario: The scratchpad file no longer exists at save time
errorCases.userImpact: Error surfaces inline in the document view; dirty remains

errorCases.detection: EACCES/ENOSPC/EROFS etc. from the temp write or the publish unlink/link; temp file unlinked, destination untouched on temp-write failure
errorCases.userImpact: No partial content is ever visible on disk; the user can retry

errorCases.detection: Non-string msg.id/msg.text or non-number msg.gen in the router's scratch-save case
errorCases.response: Dropped with log.warn, no reply (same as other malformed scratch intents)
errorCases.scenario: Malformed scratch-save payload from the webview
errorCases.userImpact: Nothing happens; the drop is visible in the extension log

invariantsToPreserve.text: CSP nonce shell (shellHtml) and the scratch-ready generation handshake stay exactly as today; content is assigned via .value, never innerHTML
Singleton panel, docGeneration/epoch guards, pendingContent replay and wrap() postMessage drop logging (ISSUE-3183af2a) are untouched

Store security invariants: id resolves strictly inside ~/.insrc/scratches root, lstat regular-file check, symlink refusal, O_NOFOLLOW fd reads, exclusive no-follow temp write + unlink/link no-clobber publish (never rename), no partial writes

Selection-based send-to-chat still works on the editable surface: the selection is read from the textarea API (selectionStart/selectionEnd over doc.value — textarea selections are not exposed via window.getSelection()), latched on select/keyup/mouseup, capped at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes by capUtf8

boundary.internal: Make the scratchpad document view editable in-plugin (ISSUE-01ac1e4b6a6c9c2f)

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

migration.backwardCompat: Both new messages are pure additions to their direction's union, so existing webviews/hosts that never send 'scratch-save' or never receive 'scratch-saved' are unaffected (old document pages never post scratch-save; unknown-type guards already drop unknown messages with a log.warn). The ScratchStore interface gains a method — the only implementors are the nodeScratchFs-backed store and the test fake, both updated in the same change. ScratchEntry shape, the ~/.insrc/scratches/*.md file layout, and all existing intents/replies are unchanged; existing scratchpad files need no rewrite and remain editable as plain files outside the plugin (the original LLD ac5 path stays valid).

migrationSteps.action: Add updateScratch(id, text) to the ScratchStore interface and nodeScratchFs implementation: re-validate id exactly as readScratch/deleteScratch (resolve strictly inside the store root, basename *.md, lstat regular file, symlink refused, O_NOFOLLOW discipline), write the new content to a temp file (pid+random suffix, never *.md) created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW (new ScratchFs.writeFileExclusive; EEXIST/ELOOP on an occupied/symlinked temp name aborts the save), then publish with the store's existing no-clobber discipline — re-open the destination with O_NOFOLLOW + fstat to confirm the validated inode, unlink(destination), link(temp, destination), unlink(temp) — NEVER rename; a concurrent recreate surfacing as EEXIST on link is re-validated and retried (bounded), otherwise unlink the temp on any failure; reject with ScratchRefused / ScratchNotFound / ScratchStoreError. Extend fake-scratch-fs.ts with the same exclusive/no-follow temp-write and link/unlink/open-fstat semantics.

Add a NEW document-channel protocol in scratch-panels.ts: ScratchDocWebviewToHost = { type: 'scratch-save'; id: string; gen: number; text: string } and ScratchDocHostToWebview = { type: 'scratch-saved'; id: string; gen: number; ok: boolean; error?: string }, each with its own const array (SCRATCH_DOC_WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES / SCRATCH_DOC_HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES) and direction-isolation assertions in scratch-panel.test.ts. Do NOT touch the chat-channel protocol.ts unions/arrays (they describe only the chat panel's channel and scratch-content/scratch-ready already live outside them); gen is carried on both messages so the reply is generation-guarded end to end.

Reshape the document view in scratch-panels.ts: <pre id="insrc-scratchdoc"> becomes <textarea id="insrc-scratchdoc" class="scratch-doc">; scratch-content sets doc.value (never innerHTML, CSP-safe); documentBootstrap(gen, id) gains the id parameter so the webview can post it back; add hidden icon save button (visible when dirty), input→dirty + panel title '•' suffix, keydown Ctrl/Cmd+S + button click → post 'scratch-save' {id, gen: docGeneration, text: doc.value} on the document channel, message 'scratch-saved' honored only when msg.gen === live docGeneration and id matches → clear dirty or show error; the panel's onMessage forwards 'scratch-save' via a NEW deps.onScratchSave seam (validated against showingId and live docGeneration) wired in extension.ts to the scratch-host route; send-to-chat selection re-pointed to the textarea API (selectionStart/selectionEnd over doc.value on select/keyup/mouseup, since window.getSelection() does not see textarea selections); ScratchPanels gains replySaved(gen, msg) targeting the live document generation; generation/epoch/ready-replay machinery and wrap() drop logging untouched.

Add the 'scratch-save' case to createScratchHost.onMessage: validate string id/text + numeric gen (warn+drop otherwise), await store.updateScratch, then reply via panels.replySaved(gen, { type:'scratch-saved', id, gen, ok, error? }) targeting the live document generation, run refreshBrowse() + sendScratchList() so the menu mtime refreshes; on store failure reply ok:false with log.warn, still refresh. WIRE THE ROUTE: the document panel's onMessage (scratch-panels.ts openDocument) forwards 'scratch-save' through a new ScratchPanelsDeps.onScratchSave seam — extension.ts sets onScratchSave: (msg) => scratchHost.onMessage(msg as never) exactly like the existing onSendToChat forward — because the chat-channel SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES interception at extension.ts:790 only sees the CHAT panel's messages.

Tests: scratch-store.test.ts (fake-scratch-fs extended with writeFileExclusive EEXIST/ELOOP semantics) for updateScratch happy path/no-partial-write/refusals/temp cleanup/mtime; NEW vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/scratch-host.test.ts for the scratch-save route (ok/ok=false/malformed/refresh calls) using the established fake-store/fake-panels pattern; scratch-panel.test.ts source+behavior pins (textarea, .value, save wiring, documentBootstrap(gen, id), gen-guarded scratch-saved, dirty, onScratchSave forwarding, document-channel direction isolation, textarea-selection send-to-chat); extension-chat-wiring.test.ts regex pins (onScratchSave wiring, replySaved). No data or state migration needed.

migration.stateAfter: The scratchpad document view is editable in-plugin: a CSP-safe <textarea> holds the content, a save button (shown only while dirty, plus a '•' title suffix) and Ctrl/Cmd+S post a new document-channel 'scratch-save' {id, gen, text} intent; the document panel forwards it via the new deps.onScratchSave seam to a new ScratchStore.updateScratch that rewrites the .md file under the store's existing strict validation (inside-root, regular-file, symlink-refused, O_NOFOLLOW) plus exclusive no-follow temp-file creation (O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW) and unlink/link no-clobber publication (never rename), then replies 'scratch-saved' {id, gen, ok, error?} through a new panels.replySaved targeting the live document generation, which clears the dirty state or surfaces the error; browse table and chat menu refresh after every save; send-to-chat selection (read from the textarea's selectionStart/selectionEnd), singleton panel, generation/epoch guards and wrap() drop logging are preserved.
migration.stateBefore: Per the s1 analyze bundle: the document view (vscode-plugin/src/panels/scratch-panels.ts documentBodyHtml:146-151 / documentBootstrap:164-205) renders a read-only <pre id="insrc-scratchdoc"> filled via textContent only, with send-to-chat over selectionchange; the host router (scratch-host.ts, six intents in SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES:19-26) has no save intent; ScratchStore (scratch-store.ts) exposes list/create/read/delete only — no update op; protocol.ts unions carry no save/saved messages. The original LLD ac5 explicitly scoped in-plugin editing OUT, which is why the view is read-only today (ISSUE-01ac1e4b6a6c9c2f, approved, sized).

messages.description: The document webview posts the textarea content whenever the user clicks Save or presses Ctrl/Cmd+S.
messages.label: scratch-save {id, gen, text}

messages.description: The host route validates the fields and calls the store's new update op.
messages.label: updateScratch(id, text)

messages.description: The store re-validates the id (inside root, regular file, symlink refused, destination re-confirmed via O_NOFOLLOW open+fstat), writes a temp file with exclusive no-follow creation, and publishes with the store's no-clobber discipline (unlink destination + link(temp, destination) + unlink(temp) — never rename), bumping mtime.
messages.label: resolve / ScratchRefused|ScratchNotFound|ScratchStoreError

messages.description: The host refreshes the browse table, re-pushes the chat scratch-list so the menu mtime updates, then answers the webview.
messages.label: refreshBrowse() + sendScratchList(); replySaved → scratch-saved {id, gen, ok, error?}

messages.description: The webview handler requires msg.gen === live docGeneration and matching id (stale-generation replies ignored, same rule as scratch-ready); ok=true clears dirty (hides the save button, clears the '•' title suffix), ok=false shows the error inline and keeps dirty. The host reaches it through ScratchPanels.replySaved(gen, msg), which targets that same live generation.
messages.label: dirty cleared / error shown
messages.note: send-to-chat over the textarea selection (selectionStart/selectionEnd) runs in parallel

sequenceDefinition.narrative: The new save interaction across the three participants (document webview, host router, store): intent, validated no-clobber write, saved/error reply, and the gen-guarded dirty-state update — this is the changed call flow of the story.

participants.label: Scratchpad document webview

participants.description: createScratchHost.onMessage in vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-host.ts; routes scratch-save to the store and replies to the panel.
participants.label: Scratch host router

summary.prose: This story makes the scratchpad document view editable in-plugin. The existing 'insrc.scratchpad' webview keeps its singleton panel, CSP shell and generation/epoch guards, but its <pre> becomes a <textarea>; a save button (and Ctrl/Cmd+S) posts a new document-channel 'scratch-save' {id, gen, text} intent (forwarded from the document panel via a new onScratchSave seam) that the host routes to a new ScratchStore.updateScratch, which rewrites the .md file with the store's existing validation plus exclusive no-follow temp-file creation and unlink/link no-clobber publication. A gen-guarded 'scratch-saved' reply (via panels.replySaved) drives a dirty indicator; the browse table and chat menu refresh after a save. Send-to-chat selection behavior is preserved via the textarea's own selection API.

body.description: Section header: the changed singleton scratchpad document pane (insrc.scratchpad) in its clean, dirty and save-error states.
body.text: Scratchpad document pane (insrc.scratchpad) — editable, with save affordance

body.description: The document pane content is now an editable full-height <textarea id="insrc-scratchdoc"> (was a read-only <pre> filled via textContent); content is pushed via .value only, never innerHTML, keeping the CSP nonce shell safe.

items.description: The editable scratchpad content as a multiline text input — the textarea replacing the read-only <pre>; unsaved edits set the dirty state.
Icon-only Save button (title="Save"), visible only while dirty; click or Ctrl/Cmd+S posts {type:"scratch-save", id, gen: docGeneration, text: doc.value} to the host.
While dirty, the panel title carries a '•' suffix so unsaved changes are visible from the tab bar.
Clean/dirty chrome of the document pane: editable textarea, save button (shown only when dirty) and the dirty title suffix.

body.description: On save success the host replies 'scratch-saved' {id, gen, ok:true} through panels.replySaved targeting the live document generation (after refreshBrowse + chat scratch-list re-push so the menu mtime updates) and the webview — honoring only a matching gen — clears dirty: save button hides, '•' suffix clears. On failure it replies ok:false with error: an inline error line shows and dirty remains. A stale-generation reply (gen older than the live docGeneration) is ignored.

items.description: Save confirmed: dirty cleared (save button hidden, title suffix removed); the browse table and chat menu show the new mtime.
Save failed: ok=false reply → error text shown inline, dirty state kept, retry possible via the save button.

body.description: Unchanged behavior preserved on the editable surface: a non-empty text selection in the textarea reveals the floating icon-only Send-to-chat button anchored at the selection; the selection text is read from the textarea API (doc.selectionStart/selectionEnd sliced out of doc.value on select/keyup/mouseup — window.getSelection() does not see textarea selections); clicking posts {type:"send-to-chat", text} (capped at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes) — the host inserts into the chat input and focuses it, never auto-sends.

uxDefinition.narrative: The changed scratchpad document view: an editable textarea filling the pane (replacing the read-only <pre>), an icon-only save button that appears only while there are unsaved edits (plus a '•' tab-title suffix), save-success and save-error states, and the preserved floating Send-to-chat button on text selection — so the editing UX and its states can be assessed.
